Whose
Bengaluru?

A visual journey through a city that has changed in scale, architecture, mobility and everyday life — while carrying older memories into its newer form.

Explore the transformation ↓

From a Garden City to a global city.

The transformation of Bengaluru is not simply a story of old buildings being replaced by new ones. It can be read through streets, trees, public spaces, businesses, transport systems and skylines. Click any photograph to pause on a particular layer of that story.

02 / The turning point

Then the city
started moving.

A growing city changes its scale. Roads become busier, buildings rise, mobility infrastructure expands and familiar neighbourhoods adapt. The transition is not a clean break: traces of the older city remain within the new one.
